resources.string: ReplyMint reads the visible conversation ONLY when you tap the bubble, and writes a draft into the reply box. It never sends anything. In the background it only checks whether a text box is on screen (to show its bubble there) — it never reads your conversation unless you tap.
One best reply, right inside any app.
ReplyMint is a tiny floating bubble that lives inside your chat apps. Tap it and a great reply appears in the text box — written for you, in your tone, ready to send.
Only in your chat apps, only on screens with a reply box.
Auto Reply drafts for you. Voice types what you say. Fix polishes what you typed.

Android will show a warning — here\'s the truth

After you turn ReplyMint on, Android will tell you it “can view your screen and perform actions.” That notice appears for every accessibility app — keyboards, dictation tools, screen readers.

What ReplyMint actually does:

• Reads the screen only when you tap the bubble — never in the background
• Writes drafts only into the text box
• Cannot press Send — that button isn't wired to anything

On the next screen, turn ReplyMint ON. Tip: you can leave the “Accessibility button/shortcut” OFF — the app uses its own bubble.
